name: Strangulation
body:
School transmutation [pain]; Level medium 3, occultist 3, psychic 3, spiritualist 3, sorcerer/wizard 3, witch 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one creature that breathes
Duration concentration up to 1 round/level
Saving Throw Fortitude partial; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You focus your mind to manipulate the airways, arresting their organs that aid in the target’s breathing, potentially choking the life out of them.

Each round you concentrate on this spell, it deals 3d8 bludgeoning damage and immobilizes the target. A creature immobilized in this way is unable to move and must hold its breath (see environmental hazards). The target creature may still attack, use abilities and cast spells (albeit impeded by the inability to breathe). Each round the spell affects the target, the target can attempt a Fortitude save to halve the damage and avoid being immobilized.
